recentItems.title: PM Modi Serious Warning to Corporates Over Jobs & Salaries | Tammareddy Bharadwaj Analysis
recentItems.description:
PM Modi Serious Warning to Corporates Over Jobs & Salaries | Tammareddy Bharadwaj Analysis #idreamnews 
#JournalistRoddamSrinivas #ThammareddyBharadwaja

In this exclusive episode of Political Punch on Edgy Media, veteran film producer and social analyst Tammareddy Bharadwaj shares his sharp analysis on PM Narendra Modi's recent stern remarks against corporate companies at the FICCI convention. Despite reducing corporate tax from 30% to 22% and offering tax exemptions up to ₹12 lakh, why has India Inc failed to generate jobs and hike employee salaries? Was PM Modi's outburst a counter-reaction to Rahul Gandhi's speech on unemployment abroad? Watch the full discussion on corporate tax exemptions, automation, gig economy, and the real state of unemployment in India.   Timestamps (చాప్టర్స్ - SEO కి చాలా ముఖ్యం):
